description: The xRegistry model for OCI container registries, describing the structure and metadata for container registries and images.

containerregistries.description: A group representing an OCI container registry provider (e.g., Docker Hub, GHCR). Contains all available container registries.

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the OCI Distribution API from which these images were projected, e.g. 'https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/'. This records provenance only; a repository name denotes the same repository whichever registry serves it.

images.description: A resource representing a container image in the registry, including its metadata and available tags/versions.

name.description: The complete OCI repository name, verbatim and unaltered, including its '/' separators (e.g. 'library/nginx'). This is the authoritative name of the image; the imageid is only an addressing key derived from it and MUST NOT be reversed to recover this value.

metadata.description: Comprehensive metadata about the container image.

digest.description: The content digest of the image manifest.

manifest_mediatype.description: The media type of the image manifest. The listed values are the common ones; any RFC 6838 conformant media type is permitted and implementations MUST NOT reject an unknown value.

artifact_type.description: The manifest 'artifactType', which discriminates non-image OCI artifacts and is the filter key of the referrers API.

subject.description: The manifest 'subject' descriptor, identifying the artifact this one is attached to (signatures, SBOMs, attestations).

schema_version.description: The schema version of the manifest. For the OCI image manifest and image index this MUST be 2.

layers_count.description: The number of layers in the image.

architecture.description: The target architecture for the container image. Values SHOULD be drawn from the Go GOARCH list; the enum below is illustrative and MUST NOT be treated as exhaustive.

os.description: The target operating system for the container image. Values SHOULD be drawn from the Go GOOS list; the enum below is illustrative and MUST NOT be treated as exhaustive.

size_bytes.description: The total size of the container image in bytes.

variant.description: Platform variant of the selected manifest (e.g., v7 for arm).

is_multi_platform.description: Whether this is a multi-platform image (manifest list).

environment.description: Environment variables defined in the image.

working_dir.description: Default working directory for the container.

user.description: Default user for running the container.

stop_signal.description: The image config 'StopSignal': the system call signal sent to the container to exit.

author.description: The image config 'author': the name and/or email address of the person or entity which created and is responsible for maintaining the image.

rootfs_diff_ids.description: The image config 'rootfs.diff_ids': the ordered list of uncompressed layer digests, base first. The corresponding 'rootfs.type' MUST be 'layers'. This array is the input to the ImageID computation.

volumes.description: Volume mount points defined in the image.

layers.description: Information about the layers that make up the image.

size.description: The size of the layer in bytes.

mediatype.description: The media type of the layer.

build_history.description: Build history and layer creation commands.

created_by.description: The command that created this layer.

empty_layer.description: Whether this step created an empty layer.

author.description: The author of this build step.

urls.description: Related URLs for the container image.

pull.description: The URL for pulling this image.

manifest.description: The URL for accessing the image manifest.

config.description: The URL for accessing the image configuration.

annotations.description: OCI manifest annotations. Both keys and values are strings; keys are conventionally in reverse domain notation.

config_labels.description: The 'Labels' map of the image configuration blob. Distinct from manifest annotations: labels are fixed at build time inside the content-addressed config blob, annotations live on the manifest and may change without rebuilding. The two MUST NOT be merged.

referrers.description: The descriptors returned by the OCI referrers API for this manifest digest, i.e. the manifests whose 'subject' points at this one. See GET /v2/<name>/referrers/<digest>.

mediatype.description: Media type of the referring manifest.

size.description: Size in bytes of the referring manifest.

artifact_type.description: The 'artifactType' of the referring manifest; the value on which the referrers API filters.

annotations.description: Annotations of the referring manifest, as returned in the referrers index.

vulnerabilities.description: Security vulnerability information if available. Not defined by the OCI specifications; the shape is scanner-specific.

pushed.description: The timestamp when the image was pushed to the registry.

sourceurl.description: Base URL of the OCI Distribution API this image was actually fetched from, e.g. 'https://registry-1.docker.io/v2/'. For a mirrored image this is the mirror rather than the registry named in the reference. This records provenance only and is not part of the image's identity.

namespace.description: The namespace or organization under which the repository is published.

repository.description: The canonical repository path within the registry, including any '/' separators.

pulled.description: Number of times this repository has been pulled. REGISTRY-PROPRIETARY and OPTIONAL: it appears in neither the OCI distribution specification nor the OCI image specification, and MUST be omitted when the registry does not publish it.

starred.description: Number of stars/favorites for this repository. REGISTRY-PROPRIETARY and OPTIONAL: it appears in neither the OCI distribution specification nor the OCI image specification, and MUST be omitted when the registry does not publish it.

deprecated_message.description: Free-text deprecation notice for the repository. REGISTRY-PROPRIETARY and OPTIONAL: it appears in neither the OCI distribution specification nor the OCI image specification. The core 'deprecated' object attribute MUST also be set when this attribute is present.
